id: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003)
title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
tagline: Marooned with a pirate. Bring the rum.
about: A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to rescue a governor's daughter from a cursed crew.
cue: Serve the drinks when Jack and Elizabeth are marooned on the island.
faces: PORT ROYAL TO ISLA DE MUERTA

Serve the drinks when Jack and Elizabeth are marooned on the island.

No complaints to the cook. Prices subject to change. Laser issue, fleet standard. Form G-882, sheet 2 of 2. 2003. Crew notes: Jack's boat sinking as he steps ashore. The compass that does not point north. The Aztec medallion.

    StartersBarbossa's green applesLime-tossed green apple slices, warm salted caramel dip, sharp cheddar shardsHow to make it3 green apples, sliced2 limes, juiced200g soft caramels3 tbsp thickened cream1 pinch of flaky salt150g sharp cheddarSlice the apples and toss in lime juice.Melt the caramels with the cream and salt until smooth.Break the cheddar into shards.Serve the apples with the warm dip and cheddar.Gold-dusted fried plantain coinsTwice-fried smashed green plantain, salted and brushed with edible goldHow to make it3 green plantains1 L vegetable oil, for frying1 tsp flaky salt1 pinch of edible gold lustrePeel the plantains and slice into thick coins.Fry in the vegetable oil at 160°C for a few minutes until just tender.Smash each coin flat.Fry again at 190°C until golden and crisp.Salt, and brush a few with gold lustre.MainsCaribbean jerk chickenCharcoal-grilled scotch bonnet jerk chicken legs with coconut rice and beansHow to make it2 scotch bonnet chillies2 tsp ground allspice1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves4 spring onions3 cloves of garlic2 limes, juiced4 chicken marylands300g long grain rice1 tin of kidney beans, drained400ml coconut milkBlitz the chillies, allspice, thyme, spring onions, garlic and lime juice into a paste.Coat the chicken and marinate overnight in the fridge.Grill slowly over coals, turning, until charred and cooked through.Cook the rice with the kidney beans, coconut milk and a little water.Serve the chicken on the rice.Port Royal coconut snapper stewThe British fort at Port RoyalHow to make itAs written, serves 4Snapper simmered gently in coconut milk with tomato, capsicum, thyme, allspice and a whole chilli, with rice and peas and fried plantain.Cook 300g rice with 1 drained tin kidney beans, 270ml coconut milk, 300ml water and thyme for 18 minutes.Soften 1 onion, 1 capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in oil, add half a teaspoon of allspice, 2 diced tomatoes, 400ml coconut milk and 1 whole scotch bonnet and simmer 10 minutes.Add 800g snapper chunks and poach 6 minutes.Fry 2 sliced ripe plantains in oil until golden.Finish the stew with lime and serve.SweetsPort Royal pineapple tartsSmall shortcrust tarts filled with thick cinnamon then cool.Remove the cinnamon and fill the tart cases.Bake until the pastry is golden.DrinksPirate's rum punchDark rum, lime, pineapple and orange juice over ice with grated nutmegHow to make it3 limes, juiced60ml sugar syrup180ml dark rum300ml pineapple juice300ml orange juice2 cups ice1 pinch of nutmeg, freshly gratedMix the lime juice, syrup, rum, pineapple juice and orange juice in a jug.Pour over ice and grate nutmeg on top.
